entries.title: Blue Stinger

emulation.notes: Use a Dreamcast emulator with an owned copy for high-resolution capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Dreamcast presentation with emulator-side resolution and capture improvements.

primary.why: Blue Stinger is a Dreamcast-only action-adventure game with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease, so the original Dreamcast version is the complete canonical release.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Dreamcast copy on original hardware, or use Flycast/Redream with an owned disc image for clean capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Dreamcast release; best available route with emulator-side scaling for capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced commercial platform, preserving the complete original release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate release with higher official fidelity or exclusive content was identified.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.
